comments.value: I guess with the pedestal picture you are wanting the default camera to try and position itself better?

details:
The avatar Pedestal and Preview system is limited and lacks effective tools to view an avatar's states before using or applying.

Avatar creators have no mechanism to view their avatar's in game states from other's perspective without using an additional account or individual helping them.

Features lacking or are in limited states with the preview system are

--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Preview avatar in blocked and default states

    *** Avatar creators cannot effectively measure how blocked shaders will impact their uploaded avatar.

    *** Avatar creators cannot view default/blocked state of toggles as it can differ from Unity and Menu states.

---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Preview avatars in 3D projection/player-game camera with SDK 3.0 type toggles

     *** Avatar creators have no tool to view in game state of avatar in surrounding space, mirrors are limited to forward visibility and the photo-camera is restrictive and has a high POE for new creators.

    *** Photo-Camera does not have Physbone component interaction capability 

    *** Creators cannot test features such as 3D/2D audio sources without a helper individual

----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Pedestal images do not reflect the avatar associated with the Pedestal

    *** Custom images could/should remain an option and simply toggled in the client options.

    *** Avatar images that are not set via SDK upload could be inferred from SDK face component and scale to capture the avatar.
title: Upgraded Avatar Pedestal and Preview
